program_solutions:
(rule!
  (let* ((h (rows g))
           (w (cols g))
           (orange (filter (lambda (o) (= (obj-color o) 7)) (objects g 0))))
      (for/fold ([out g]) ([obj orange])
        (if (any? (lambda (p) (or (= (first p) 0) (= (first p) (- h 1)) (= (second p) 0) (= (second p) (- w 1)))) (obj-cells obj))
            (paint-cells out (obj-cells obj) 3)
            out))))
